title: Anthropic Partners With Hg to Launch Independent European AI Consultancy
summary:
The frontier lab is creating a separate entity to provide artificial intelligence expertise to corporate clients across Europe through a partnership with London-based private equity firm Hg. This venture marks the first time Anthropic has established an independent business to sell its AI specialized services.

The consultancy will launch by the end of 2026 and will operate through hubs in London and Berlin. The firm plans to deploy AI engineers and consultants directly into European companies to help integrate artificial intelligence into their business operations.

Anthropic is launching a European consultancy that:

"will embed AI consultants and engineers into European businesses"

A large proportion of the UK economy is based on professional services / consultancies. 

Anthropic is swooping in to gobble it up.
